mission_epoch.basis: NASA reported liftoff at 6:35 p.m. EDT on April 1, 2026; EDT is UTC-04:00.
mission_epoch.precision: minute-level source timestamp; seconds are not known from this source alone

important_note: This dataset deliberately separates press-kit planned checkpoints from launch-day-published checkpoints and later completed TLI reporting. These are reference events, not continuous telemetry. Do not fabricate continuous state vectors between them or claim they are exact flight truth states.

modeling_rules: Keep press-kit planned event times and launch-day-published event references in separate fields.
Treat event-time targets as validation checkpoints, not as replacement state data.
Do not infer full position/velocity/attitude histories from event times alone.
Any calculated event time must identify model version, state, root-finding method, source checkpoint, and residual.
The post-TLI state passed to AIM 2 must be generated by the same modeled event sequence and numerical state history.
